sets.title: Quick test: Qwen 3.8 Max
sets.description: One model for every operation; the cheapest setup and the model selected for beta qualification (ADR-076).
notes: Measured working limits: 16,384 output tokens, 180 s provider timeout (docs/evaluations/p7-qwen38-reasoning-budget-2026-09-22.md).

sets.title: Qwen 3.8 family
sets.description: Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 models at descending capability levels, all on Alibaba's own endpoint.
notes: Research advises medium reasoning effort; default high effort overthinks.

sets.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 family
sets.description: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna at descending capability levels.
notes: Uses OpenAI flex processing: about half price, slower, and occasionally unavailable when busy. VCP never retries, so a busy period fails visibly.
Standard-processing endpoints put Sol's full-context probe above the $25 setup ceiling, and the openai endpoint cannot be pinned alone because openai/flex and openai/fast are listed under it.
Research records a high reward-hacking rate for Sol; keep autonomy at ask.

sets.title: Anthropic Claude family
sets.description: Claude Opus 5, Sonnet 5 and Haiku 4.5 at descending capability levels.
notes: The anthropic endpoint cannot be pinned alone for Opus 5 because the catalog also lists anthropic/fast; Vertex global has the same price.
Sonnet 5 and Haiku 4.5 have no level in the research table yet.
Fable 5.1 is not offered: its full-context probe reservation exceeds the $25 setup ceiling.

sets.title: Z.ai GLM 5.3 family
sets.description: GLM 5.3 with GLM 5.3 Flash helpers, pinned to Z.ai's own endpoint.
notes: Research reports thinking loops on some other hosts; the set pins Z.ai.
GLM 5.3 has a custom license; review it before use.

sets.title: Frontier
sets.description: Highest-capability main model with cheaper cross-vendor helpers.
notes: Opus 5 reserves about $20 per full-context request; budgets must cover that reservation.

sets.title: High
sets.description: High-level models from three vendors, so one vendor outage does not stop every operation.
notes: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is not offered yet: VCP's catalog parser does not accept its time-of-day pricing tiers.

sets.title: Medium
sets.description: Lowest-cost set: GLM 5.3 Flash with Qwen 3.8 Flash helpers.
notes: Medium-level models; expect weaker results on long or complex tasks.
